title: Utility-Driven Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts
quote: draft tokens collectively activate more weights, increasing data movement and verification time by 2-3x
proves: For MoE targets, verification of K drafts raises expert weight traffic 2-3x; speculation can slow decoding up to 1.5x; Cascade toggles speculation by a utility ratio.
does_not_prove: Evaluated on one RTX 6000 Ada with vLLM 0.6.6/0.8.2, single-batch; no TP, EP or all-to-all cost in the model.
bearing: Supports: MoE verification cost depends on topology; leaves EP case open

title: The Limits of Speculation: Bounding Speculative Decoding in Mixture-of-Experts
quote: Speculative decoding in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models faces the problem of unstable verification cost
proves: Frames MoE speculation-budget choice as an offline stochastic shortest path problem with a counterfactual oracle of verification cost from input-dependent expert loading.
does_not_prove: Abstract says nothing about EP, TP or multi-GPU; oracle is offline, not a runtime policy under topology change.
bearing: Threatens novelty of 'optimal K for MoE' framing; EP not covered

title: MoE-Spec: Expert Budgeting for Efficient Speculative Decoding
quote: We propose MoE-Spec, a training-free verification-time expert budgeting method
proves: Capping experts loaded per layer during verification gives 10-30% higher throughput than EAGLE-3 baselines.
does_not_prove: 1-2 A100s, no TP/EP stated; authors say batch inference changes the tradeoffs; nothing about cross-device expert placement.
bearing: Threatens 'expert-aware verification' as new; EP version open

title: Less Experts, Faster Decoding: Cost-Aware Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts
quote: EcoSpec consistently reduces active expert footprints and improves end-to-end decoding speed,
proves: EcoSpec picks drafts by expert activation cost; up to 1.62x on DeepSeek-V3.1, Qwen3-235B-A22B, GPT-OSS-120B.
does_not_prove: HF Transformers prototype on 8 H200; cost model is per-device HBM expert traffic, no EP or all-to-all modeling.
bearing: Threatens expert-cost-aware drafting; leaves EP/all-to-all cost term open

title: MoESD: Unveil Speculative Decoding's Potential for Accelerating Sparse MoE
quote: under medium batch sizes, MoE surprisingly benefits more from SD than dense models
proves: SD helps MoE more than dense at medium batch (up to 2.29x for Qwen2-57B-A14B); ineffective at small batch.
does_not_prove: Abstract does not establish multi-GPU or EP setups; per-rank batch under EP differs from global batch.
bearing: Supports batch-regime models; EP shifts per-rank batch so regime may move

title: Why Speculative Decoding Works Better Than Predicted on Sparse MoE Models
quote: recent fine-grained models break this trend, showing higher speedup at low batch size
proves: Fine-grained MoE layers run faster than predicted at low batch (small expert weights, L2 hits), so SD gains at low batch exceed MoESD's model.
does_not_prove: Abstract never mentions expert parallelism; single-device kernel dynamics only.
bearing: Weakens simple cost models; EP effects unstudied

title: EasySpec: Layer-Parallel Speculative Decoding for Efficient Multi-GPU Utilization
quote: the optimal TP size of the draft model is typically smaller than that of the base model
proves: Drafter at small TP leaves GPUs idle during drafting; layer-parallel drafting gives peak 4.17x over vanilla decoding.
does_not_prove: Static topology; does not study what happens when target TP changes at runtime.
bearing: Threatens 'drafter TP mismatch' as new; supports TP-coupled tuning

title: SwiftSpec: Ultra-Low Latency LLM Decoding by Scaling Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
quote: redesigns the speculative decoding pipeline in an asynchronous and disaggregated manner
proves: Draft and target scaled separately on disjoint GPUs; 1.75x over SOTA SD; Llama3-70B at 348 tok/s on 8 Hopper GPUs.
does_not_prove: Fixed GPU split, latency-only (low batch); no runtime reshard or failure.
bearing: Threatens disaggregated drafter placement ideas

title: SpecPipe: Accelerating Pipeline Parallelism-based LLM Inference with Speculative Decoding
quote: The pipeline inference framework follows node-wise computation, pruning propagation, and inter-node communication stages.
proves: Speculation fills PP bubbles: 8-stage pipeline 4.19-5.53x TBT over plain PP; SpecPipe-DB 1.64-2.08x throughput over vLLM.
does_not_prove: Fixed pipeline depth; no stage add/remove or failure.
bearing: Threatens 'spec decode for PP' novelty

title: Approaching the Acceptance-Limited Ideal Speedup: Speculative Decoding on Tenstorrent Galaxy
quote: We implement MTP with TT-NN tensor and expert parallelism on four Wormhole Galaxies
proves: DeepSeek-R1 MTP with TP+EP and pipeline variants reach 87-93% of acceptance-limited ideal speedup (1.60x-3.57x) at concurrency one.
does_not_prove: Concurrency one only; topology fixed per experiment; no cross-topology comparison of optimal K.
bearing: Shows near-ideal SD is reachable under EP at batch 1; high-batch EP open

title: Elastic Expert Parallelism in vLLM
quote: Elastic EP scales by adding or removing data-parallel (DP) workers.
proves: Runtime DP/EP scale-up/down: standby comm groups, non-expert weight transfer, CUDA graph reset, EPLB reshuffle after (up) or before (down). Next steps list lack of MoE draft/drafter model support.
does_not_prove: No downtime numbers; drafter/MTP behaviour across a reshard is explicitly unsupported, not measured.
bearing: Supports gap: drafter not following elastic reshard

title: [RFC]: Elastic DP Rank Recovery: Graceful Handling of GPU Hardware Failures Without Full Cluster Restart (#30112)
quote: vLLM currently terminates the entire serving cluster, even when running with multiple Data Parallel (DP) ranks.
proves: Proposes surviving DP/EP ranks rebuild NCCL without the failed rank and reuse MoE scale-down to redistribute experts.
does_not_prove: No mention of speculative decoding, MTP or drafter state on failure; RFC stale-closed then reopened.
bearing: Supports gap: failure-driven reshard with spec decode unaddressed

title: Speculative Decoding (vLLM docs, latest)
quote: Pipeline parallelism is not composable with speculative decoding as of `vllm<=0.15.0`
proves: Documents draft_tensor_parallel_size as a separate drafter TP knob and a historic PP incompatibility.
does_not_prove: Silent on DP/EP compatibility; does not describe current PP support status.
bearing: Context: drafter TP decoupled from target TP

title: [Bug]: Qwen3.5 does not work with pipeline parallelism (#36643)
quote: vLLM does not currently support enabling both pipeline parallelism and speculative decoding at the same time.
proves: As of March 2026, MTP draft for Qwen3.5 lacked SupportsPP; PP=4 + MTP failed; closed not planned.
does_not_prove: Model-specific; later PRs (D15-D17) partially change this.
bearing: Shows PP+spec is young and brittle

title: [Bugfix] Support MTP speculative decoding with pipeline parallelism on the PD producer side (#46003)
quote: local drafters (Eagle, MTP) are loaded only on the **last PP rank** with an effective PP size of 1
proves: Drafter always lives on the last PP rank at PP=1; PR permits MTP+PP only on the prefill producer because the decode-side loop cannot coordinate draft tokens across stages.
does_not_prove: Open PR; no performance data on last-stage drafter imbalance.
bearing: Supports gap: drafter placement imbalance under PP

title: [Bug]: speculative decoding under pipeline parallelism produces wrong output with --no-async-scheduling (#52071)
quote: With `--no-async-scheduling`, speculative decoding under pipeline parallelism produces wrong output
proves: Under PP 2/4/8, base scheduler never sets next_decode_eligible_step; ~25% of spec steps use token 0 as anchor and output degrades.
does_not_prove: Correctness bug, not performance; fixed path is async scheduler only.
bearing: Supports: PP+spec state hand-off is fragile

title: [Bugfix][Spec Decode] Serialize batch queue for spec decode + PP (#61326)
quote: the PP batch queue schedules step N+1 before step N's output is processed
proves: Spec decode + PP + non-async crashes worker (GLM-5.3 MTP at PP=3/TP=2, OLMoE ngram at PP=2); fix serializes the batch queue, giving up PP overlap in that mode.
does_not_prove: Open PR; cost of serialization not measured.
bearing: Shows PP microbatch overlap and spec drafts conflict

title: [Bug]: structured output can sample unconstrained tokens when the draft hand-off goes stale (spec decode + async scheduling + PP) (#54437)
quote: The draft-token hand-off from the worker to the scheduler carries no identity
proves: DraftTokensHandler single slot is overwritten per execute_model; with PP interleaving, grammar mask fails open and unconstrained tokens can be emitted.
does_not_prove: Latent at filing; fixed fail-closed by #54442; acceptance cost addressed in D19.
bearing: Ownership of drafts under PP microbatches; consistency lens

title: [Feature][Spec Decode] Per-request draft retention for structured output under PP (#61348)
quote: draft acceptance collapses under concurrency without this change (84.7% → 0.4–9.5% measured) and decode slows 2.4×
proves: Under PP + async + structured output, acceptance fell from 84.7% to 0.4-9.5% and decode slowed 2.4x until drafts are kept per request.
does_not_prove: Open PR; one workload; structured output only.
bearing: Shows PP topology silently destroys acceptance; likely being fixed upstream

title: [DSpark] Support pipeline-parallel targets in disaggregated and aggregated serving (#53577)
quote: the decode-side drafter started cold (measured per-token acceptance dropped from ~45% to ~35% in PD vs aggregated serving)
proves: DFlash/DSpark drafter cannot run under PP; PP>1 prefill producer could not warm draft context, dropping acceptance ~45% to ~35%; PR forces drafter PP=1 and mentions drafter EPLB registration.
does_not_prove: Closed unmerged; NIXL connector unsupported for this layout.
bearing: Topology choice changes acceptance, not just cost

title: [Spec] Enable adaptive speculative decoding under DP attention (#35898)
quote: If ranks disagree, the collective shapes diverge and NCCL hangs.
proves: Under DP attention, per-rank num_steps sets the MLP-sync all_gather shape, so adaptive speculation was disabled; PR uses min() consensus over ranks.
does_not_prove: Closed unmerged; adaptive K itself was killed in R04.
bearing: Shows DP/EP couples per-rank speculation config

title: [Spec] Stabilize the DP adaptive tier vote: shared EMA + min dwell (#39231)
quote: ~1100 tier switches/h
proves: On GLM-5.2 tp8/dp8/ep8, min-of-8 consensus thrashes tiers (~1100 switches/h at per-rank batch ~1, c16 ITL p95 +14% vs fixed); fix shares EMA and adds dwell.
does_not_prove: Closed unmerged; one model and box.
bearing: Cross-rank consensus for spec config under EP is unsettled

title: Speculative Decoding (SGLang docs)
quote: Standalone speculative decoding currently does not support DP attention (`--attn-dp-size` > 1).
proves: DFlash requires no DP attention and pp_size==1; NGRAM and STANDALONE lack DP attention; UNO needs TP=PP=1.
does_not_prove: Docs say nothing about EP or drafter TP; support matrix only.
bearing: Many proposers cannot follow DP/PP topologies

title: SGLang MTP blog (DeepSeek V3)
quote: MTP unlocks up to 60% higher output throughput for DeepSeek V3 without any loss in generation quality.
proves: MTP works with large-scale EP, DP attention and PD; gain drops from +60% (small scale) to +14.2% (large-scale EP, 128 req/rank); advises draft size 2-3 near capacity.
does_not_prove: No breakdown of why gain shrinks at large EP (all-to-all vs batch).
bearing: Supports: SD gain shrinks with EP scale; cause unexplained

title: DeepSeek R1 MTP Implementation and Optimization (TensorRT-LLM tech blog)
quote: MTP=3 can help get the best min-latency performance on 8 B200 GPUs
proves: MTP nextn=3 gives 2.16x (2.33x relaxed acceptance) at batch 1 on 8 B200 with MLA TP=8, MoE EP=2.
does_not_prove: Min-latency batch 1 only; no MTP weight sharding detail or throughput regime.
bearing: Baseline for MTP under TP/EP

title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
quote: the acceptance rate of the second token prediction ranges between 85% and 90% across various generation topics
proves: MTP shares embedding/output head with main model; training co-locates shallowest and deepest layers on one PP rank; MTP gives 1.8x TPS at inference.
does_not_prove: PP placement is for training (DualPipe); inference MTP placement under EP not detailed in the part read.
bearing: Context: MTP placement tied to embedding/head location

title: SpotServe: Serving Generative Large Language Models on Preemptible Instances
quote: SpotServe dynamically adapts the LLM parallelization configuration for dynamic instance availability
proves: Re-parallelizes on spot preemption with fine-grained progress commit; P99 2.4-9.1x lower, 54% cheaper.
does_not_prove: No mention of speculative decoding or drafter state.
bearing: Gap: re-parallelization ignores drafter

title: ShuntServe: Cost-Efficient LLM Serving on Heterogeneous Spot GPU Clusters
quote: Heterogeneous clusters spanning multiple GPU types can address this
proves: Heterogeneous spot clusters (L4, A10G, L40S) with output-preserving migration; 1.42x/1.35x throughput, ~31% cost gain.
does_not_prove: No speculative decoding.
bearing: Gap: heterogeneous spot + SD unstudied

title: A Pipelined Collaborative Speculative Decoding Framework for Efficient Edge-Cloud LLM Inference (PicoSpec)
quote: resolves the mutual waiting problem inherent in vanilla speculative decoding within edge collaboration scenarios
proves: Pipelines edge drafting with cloud verification; up to 2.9x speedup.
does_not_prove: Abstract does not quantify WAN RTT sensitivity.
bearing: Threatens edge-cloud pipelining ideas

title: DSD: A Distributed Speculative Decoding Solution for Edge-Cloud Agile Large Model Serving
quote: DSD-Sim, a discrete-event simulator that captures network, batching, and scheduling dynamics
proves: Multi-device draft-target SD with a network-aware simulator; up to 1.1x speedup and 9.7% throughput over SD baselines.
does_not_prove: Small gains; network conditions not detailed in abstract.
bearing: Weak result: edge-cloud SD gains small at scale

title: DSSD: Efficient Edge-Device LLM Deployment and Collaborative Inference via Distributed Split Speculative Decoding
quote: replaces the uplink transmission of multiple vocabulary distributions with a single downlink transmission
proves: Splits verification between device and edge to cut uplink of vocab distributions.
does_not_prove: No numbers in abstract.
bearing: Threatens communication-reduced split SD

title: Quantize-Sample-and-Verify: LLM Acceleration via Adaptive Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding
quote: dynamically adjusting the draft length and quantization precision
proves: Adapts draft length and quantization of draft distributions to channel conditions to maximize throughput.
does_not_prove: Signal-processing model; no serving-system evaluation in abstract.
bearing: Threatens network-adaptive K

title: SLED: A Speculative LLM Decoding Framework for Efficient Edge Serving
quote: the edge server batch the diverse verification requests from devices
proves: Heterogeneous edge devices draft, one shared server batches verification; 2.2x throughput, 2.8x capacity (Jetson, RPi, 4 A100).
does_not_prove: Position paper; preliminary numbers.
bearing: Threatens device-draft/server-verify

title: SP-MoE: Speculative Decoding and Prefetching for Accelerating MoE-based Model Inference
quote: combining MoE with SD inflates GPU memory and aggravates CPU-GPU bandwidth contention
proves: Uses draft-target structural correspondence to prefetch offloaded experts; 1.07-3.5x TPOT.
does_not_prove: Offloading (CPU-GPU), not multi-GPU EP.
bearing: Threatens draft-guided expert prefetch; EP analogue open

title: GLM 5.1 PP support (vLLM forum)
quote: Keep the MTP draft model only on the last PP stage.
proves: User asks for MTP drafter only on last PP stage with TP+PP across nodes; bot reply says unsupported (May 2026).
does_not_prove: Bot answer, not maintainer; superseded in part by D15.
bearing: Shows demand for drafter-on-last-stage layouts
